correctness.rationale: All 4095 nonzero 12-coefficient bihomogeneous equations were accounted for by an independently constructed exact PGL2(F2)^2 orbit action (165 orbits); four-chart mod-2 Gröbner tests on every representative classified 39 smooth orbits of total weight 1116. The weighted joint (N1,p-rank) table was reconstructed exactly, with p-rank totals 288,216,612. Separately, GF4 point counts and characteristic-two genus-two Weil zeta parity reproduced rank classifications on all 39 smooth orbits. For smooth (2,3) curves adjunction gives genus (2−1)(3−1)=2, and separable quadratic projection B≠0 gives p-rank = number of distinct zeros of homogeneous branch cubic B minus one. Explicit fixed coordinates and equation-weighting, not isomorphism classes, are essential. These exhaustive computations cover the finite domain; no general q claim is made.
